concepts.way: misconception: wrong rule: a = b copies the value of a into b.
concepts.why: These values come from reading each assignment backwards, copying left into right. Java gives a = 7, b = 7, c = 7.
The answer gives only final values and says nothing about variables themselves. The wrong values come from the assignment misconception, not a variable rule.
